fact: The national AI strategy to 2030 provides for acquiring supercomputers, shared computing clusters open to universities, startups and firms, a national mini-supercomputer, sectoral national datasets and a language model in local languages.
title: Stratégie Nationale de l'Intelligence Artificielle à l'horizon 2030
publisher: Ministère de la Transition Numérique et de la Digitalisation, Côte d'Ivoire
